_source: X12 Remittance Advice Remark Codes, https://x12.org/codes/remittance-advice-remark-codes. Descriptions shortened; only codes this system uses are included.

codes.description: Service denied because payment already made for same/similar procedure within set time frame.
Claim contains incomplete and/or invalid information; no appeal rights because the claim is unprocessable. Submit a new claim.
Claim information is inconsistent with pre-certified/authorized services.
The number of days or units of service exceeds our acceptable maximum.
